Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1023
Claimant:
William Pierce
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2023-10-31
First notice of loss received from the policyholder reporting a low-speed collision in a parking lot, with the claimant's
vehicle reported as the other car involved. Claim file opened and the insured's coverage confirmed, with the driver
listed as a household member of the policyholder.
2023-11-20
Reviewed the photos submitted by the insured, which confirm some details of the scene, including the position of both
vehicles. The damage to the claimant's vehicle matches the impact as described, and no earlier damage to that
vehicle is known.
2024-02-22
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the first report. The police report and the
statements taken at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. No independent witnesses have
come forward.
2024-03-31
Claimant reports neck pain following the collision and has been seen by a treating provider. No earlier injury to the
same area of the body is known, but it is not yet clear whether this injury came from this crash.
2024-04-12
Treatment has followed a usual course and has tapered off as the claimant improved. Nothing in the file suggests the
damage or the injury happened before the coverage period began.
2024-05-14
Reviewed the file with the treatment records and vehicle estimate on hand. The injury question remains open pending
further medical review, while the vehicle damage and coverage points are settled.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
